note: SYNTHETIC. Simplified shape loosely modeled on Snowflake INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES/COLUMNS. Not a real export and not produced by a Snowflake connection.

tables.name: ORDERS_STG
tables.comment: Landing table for order headers from the demo order-management system. Rows are appended by COPY INTO from the S3 stage @RAW.OMS_STAGE every hour. Updated orders arrive as new rows with a later UPDATED_AT.

columns.name: ORDER_ID
columns.comment: Natural key of the order in the source system.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ID
columns.comment: Natural key of the customer. Can be null for guest checkouts.

columns.name: ORDER_TOTAL
columns.comment: Gross order value including tax, before discounts.

columns.name: DISCOUNT_AMT
columns.comment: Total discount applied to the order.

columns.name: UPDATED_AT
columns.comment: Source system last-modified timestamp. Drives the incremental extract.

columns.name: _LOADED_AT
columns.comment: When COPY INTO loaded the row.

tables.name: CUSTOMERS_STG
tables.comment: Daily full snapshot of customer profiles from the demo CRM. Contains no direct contact details; only segment and region attributes are shipped.

columns.name: SIGNUP_DATE
columns.comment: Date the customer account was created.

tables.name: PRODUCTS_STG
tables.comment: Daily full extract of the product catalog.

columns.name: IS_ACTIVE
columns.comment: False when the SKU is discontinued.

tables.name: RETURNS_STG
tables.comment: Return records delivered by the demo logistics partner as CSV files. Loaded by COPY INTO from the external stage @RAW.PARTNER_STAGE; see the partner feed onboarding runbook.

columns.name: RECEIVED_TS
columns.comment: When the partner received the item.
